main_topics: Data-driven decision making in real estate

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Listings sitting too long on the market
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Implement a three-weekend system focusing on launch, verdict, and reset to ensure listings sell quickly.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Lack of structured launch for listings
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Create a launch plan involving a teaser, open house, and social media push to maximize initial interest.

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Adapting strategies to different market conditions
problems_addressed.solution_summary: Adjust the three-weekend system to fit the median time homes spend on the market in different areas.

episode_summary: This episode of Coffee Talks with DJ Paris and Tim Littleton explores a strategic three-weekend system for real estate listings, focusing on launch, verdict, and reset phases. By leveraging data and structured planning, agents can improve sales outcomes and avoid common pitfalls like price reductions and stale listings. The discussion also emphasizes adapting strategies to different market conditions.
